sloka: इति उक्त्वा प्राक्षिपत् राजा मंत्र पूतम् जलम् तदा ।साधु साधु इति देवानाम् ऋषीणाम् वदताम् तदा ॥१-७३-२८॥
transliteration: iti uktvā prākṣipat rājā maṁtra pūtam jalam tadā ।sādhu sādhu iti devānām ṛṣīṇām vadatām tadā ॥1-73-28॥

translations.english: By being a devoted wife this highly fortunate Sita would always follow you like a shadow". Thus spoken, he sprinkled the water sanctified with mantras (on them).
